title: As-Salam and the Kind Word
summary: Allah says: ﴿وَقُولُوا لِلنَّاسِ حُسْنًا﴾ (Surah Al-Baqarah, verse 83 — interpretation of the meaning: “And speak to people good [words].”) Teach your child as-salam (the greeting of peace) upon entering and saying thank you when given something; the Prophet ﷺ said: «And the good word is sadaqah (charity)» (Sahih al-Bukhari 2989), and planting it early shapes a beautiful heart and tongue.
try_this: Today: When you enter the house, give as-salam in a clear voice, and encourage your child to imitate you and return the greeting.
reflection_prompts: Has your child started giving as-salam?
